## Change

Describe the behavior a caller observes and why it should change.

## Verification

- [ ] Listed the test commands and outcomes, including any skipped live backends.
- [ ] Updated affected usage, version, migration or API documentation.
- [ ] Explained the impact on enforcement and conformance, including guarded reads, revocation, and purge where relevant.
- [ ] Signed off commits as described in CONTRIBUTING.md.
